response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of full-stack experience, strong recent work in TypeScript/Node.js/React, hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling development, and a demonstrated testing-first engineering culture (TDD, CI/CD, test frameworks he authored). Gaps around Nest.js, Kotlin, and the specific testing tools listed (Vitest/Playwright) are minor and readily learnable given his breadth across languages and platforms.
strengths: Deep full-stack experience with the core stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes
Direct AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus open-source and teaching contributions
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience mentioned in the resume
Kotlin absent and Java experience appears dated/limited relative to the secondary stack needs
Vitest, Jest, and Playwright are not explicitly listed despite strong general testing background
